property_summary: For any non-negative _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract sets MinSum to exactly _val (assignment), whereas the mutant subtracts _val from the existing MinSum so for some fuzzed _val (e.g. non-zero) the resulting MinSum differs; we assert that after calling SetMinSum(x) the public getter MinSum equals x.
change_summary: Subtract the provided value from MinSum instead of assigning it, changing MinSum observable after the call.
